verdict.rationale: The CLI (`rcli`/`wally`) can run models locally without a GUI or account (docs-6, docs-7, docs-14) and the Wally Cloud endpoint is OpenAI-compatible for programmatic access (docs-4), suggesting some non-interactive usage is possible. However, there is no explicit documentation of headless server deployment, daemon/service mode, or CI pipeline integration, and community reports note install/segfault issues with the CLI tool. Missing for 10: explicit CI/server deployment guide, evidence of running as a background service, confirmation of stability in non-interactive environments.
